description: The practice of building and testing every change automatically on a clean machine before it joins the main branch.
A YAML file in .github/workflows that defines when GitHub Actions runs and which jobs and steps it executes.
Saved download data, such as the local Maven repository or the npm cache, that speeds up a job without changing its result.
A file a job stores, such as a jar, so later jobs or people can use it instead of rebuilding.
A rule, such as a required check or a coverage floor, that blocks a merge when it fails.
An action referenced by a full commit SHA instead of a movable tag, so the code that runs cannot change silently.
The access granted to GITHUB_TOKEN in a workflow, kept to read-only by default and raised only for the job that needs more.
